name: Ricardo Almeida Costa
title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
summary: Highly accomplished Senior Embedded Systems Engineer with over 10 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying robust firmware and hardware solutions for industrial automation and IoT devices. Proven ability to lead complex projects from concept to production, optimize system performance, and mentor junior engineers.
skills: Communication Protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet, Modbus)

bullets: Led the firmware development for a new line of industrial IoT gateways, reducing time-to-market by 25% through agile methodologies.
Optimized RTOS-based embedded software for power consumption, extending battery life by 40% on low-power devices.
Implemented secure boot and firmware update mechanisms, achieving a 99.9% reliability rate in field deployments.
Mentored a team of 3 junior engineers, improving team productivity by 15% through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
Developed embedded C firmware for real-time control systems in automotive applications, reducing latency by 30%.
Designed and implemented communication drivers for CAN bus and Ethernet, ensuring interoperability with various vehicle ECUs.
Contributed to hardware design reviews, identifying and resolving potential signal integrity issues before PCB fabrication, saving an estimated R$50,000 in redesign costs.
Developed and debugged firmware for consumer electronics using STM32 microcontrollers, achieving a 95% bug resolution rate.
Assisted in hardware testing and validation, contributing to the successful launch of 2 new product lines.
Created automated test scripts in C, reducing manual testing effort by 20%.
